## AI-assisted engineering

- [ ] Regression tests were added or existing tests cover the change.
- [ ] cargo check --workspace --all-targets passes.
- [ ] cargo test --workspace --all-targets passes.
- [ ] Clippy was run where applicable.
- [ ] Cross-crate integration was verified where applicable.
